Appeals Department

Re: Appeal of Prior Authorization Denial  
Member: Rowan Novak  
Member ID: W671638429  
Reference number: POC-7CD7D16B79-75735  
Requested service: Partial knee replacement  
CPT: 27446  
Denial notice date: August 16, 2026

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for partial knee replacement, CPT 27446. The denial states that the submitted records did not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment before surgery.

The clinical record documents extensive and unsuccessful conservative treatment:

- I have had 18 months of progressive knee pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- I completed 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy from March 22, 2026, through June 28, 2026. The treatment consisted of 20 completed visits focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion. This is documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for four months without adequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on May 7, 2026. It provided only two weeks of partial relief.
- Despite these measures, I continue to have severe pain and substantial functional impairment. I cannot climb stairs without assistance and wake three to four times every night because of pain.
- Examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.

The objective findings also establish advanced structural disease. MRI performed June 20, 2026, showed full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial compartment with bone-on-bone apposition and Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 medial disease. These findings support the medical necessity of partial knee replacement for the affected compartment after failure of nonoperative treatment.

The clinical record further documents that there is no active infection, untreated substance use, or other identified contraindication. My BMI is 29, and I am a nonsmoker. The requested procedure was recommended by Okafor, MD, orthopedic surgery.

Accordingly, the record demonstrates prolonged symptoms, failed supervised physical therapy, failed medication treatment, only brief and incomplete response to injection therapy, severe functional limitation, and advanced radiographic disease. The stated reason for denial has been addressed by the records submitted with this appeal.

I request that Healthy Blue:

1. Overturn the denial and approve prior authorization for partial knee replacement, CPT 27446;
2. Conduct an expedited review if my treating surgeon determines that delay would jeopardize my health or ability to regain function; and
3. Provide the exact medical policy or clinical-review guideline, version or effective date, and specific conservative-treatment criteria applied to this determination.

I have not been provided with a publicly accessible Healthy Blue Louisiana policy containing the specific medical-necessity criteria applied to CPT 27446, so this appeal does not quote or assume any plan policy language. If Healthy Blue relies on proprietary clinical-review criteria, please identify those criteria and explain how the submitted records were evaluated against them.

Please include the reference number above in all correspondence. Please confirm receipt of this appeal and notify me of the appeal determination in writing.

Sincerely,

Rowan Novak  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]  

Enclosures:

- Denial notice dated August 16, 2026
- Physical therapy discharge note documenting 20 visits from March 22, 2026, through June 28, 2026
- Medication-treatment history documenting four months of NSAID use
- Corticosteroid injection record dated May 7, 2026
- MRI report dated June 20, 2026
- Orthopedic examination and surgical recommendation from Okafor, MD
- Relevant clinical records and imaging reports
